headline: Congress in pro forma mode as both chambers take light schedule before August recess wind-down.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on August 20 for just 40 seconds, adjourning until Monday. No committee meetings were held.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met at 10 a.m. and adjourned at 10:03 a.m. on August 20, introducing 20 public bills and one resolution. Eight bills received committee reports, including measures on the Law Enforcement Museum, urban bird programs, and antisemitic discrimination on campuses.
